svg.title: Vector Search — distributed systems
svg.desc: From-scratch HNSW in C++ behind four Go- coordinated shards. Writes hit a checksummed WAL before memory; recovery survives a hard kill. 95% recall@10 · <50 ms p99 at 100 QPS
